name: Infused Change (Conduit Force of Nature)
body:
Infused change abilities are about empowering your form with abilities related to your force of nature.

Infused Change (Su)

You use your connection to the forces of nature to empower yourself. You may spend 1 primal point as a move action to gain a benefit for 1 round per class level.

You may expend a second primal point to extend the duration to 1 minute per class level. You gain one of the following benefits:

+10 enhancement bonus to your base speed.
+2 bonus to two ability scores determined by your force of nature as detailed below:
Fauna – Strength and Constitution
Flames – Dexterity and Intelligence
Land – Constitution and Wisdom
Ocean – Strength and Wisdom
Rime – Strength and Intelligence
Sky – Dexterity and Charisma
Verdant – Dexterity and Wisdom
+2 enhancement bonus to natural armor
Infused Change, Improved (Su)

Prerequisite(s): infused change primal ability, 7th-level conduit.

You can use your ability to infuse yourself with power to alter some aspects of your body. When using the infused change primal ability you may choose to gain two of the following abilities in addition to the benefit gained from infused change.

20 feet of extra movement mode determined by the force of nature you are connected to as follows:
Fauna – fly (average), climb, or swim
Flames – fly (average)
Land – climb
Ocean – swim
Rime – climb or swim
Sky – fly (average)
Verdant – climb
An additional +2 bonus to the ability scores granted by embodiment.
One natural attack determined by the force of nature you are connected to as follows:
Fauna – bite 1d6, 2 claws 1d4, gore 1d6, hoof 1d6, pincer 1d6, tail slap 1d6, sting 1d4, 2 talons 1d4, tentacle 1d4, 2 wings 1d4
Flames – Add 1d4 fire to existing attacks
Land – slam 1d6
Ocean – bite 1d6, pincer 1d6, sting 1d4, tail slap 1d6, 2 talons 1d4, tentacle 1d4
Rime – Add 1d4 cold to existing attacks
Sky – bite 1d6, 2 claws 1d4, sting 1d4, 2 wings 1d4
Verdant – bite 1d6, vine strike 1d4
An ability from the following list: blindsense 20 ft., constrict (requires a tentacle or tail slap natural attack), darkvision 60 ft., grab (requires a bite, claw pincer, or talon natural attack) low-light vision, Pounce (requires multiple natural attacks), rend (requires multiple claw, pincer or talon attacks), or scent.
An additional +2 enhancement bonus to natural armor.
Infused Change, Greater (Su)

Prerequisite(s): improved infused change primal ability, 15th-level conduit.

Your ability to empower your body with primal energy has peaked. When using the infused change primal ability, you gain one of the following benefits in addition to the previous benefits:

+10 enhancement bonus to all movement modes.
+2 enhancement bonus to one ability score, which stacks with the ability score enhancement bonuses from infused change.
All dice for natural weapons are increased by one and the attacks are treated as magical for purposes of damage resistance.
+4 additional enhancement bonus to natural armor.

Polymorph: The Conduit, © 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: Connor Bates.
